text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling Stock B and C for gains felt satisfying, but the account still declined overall; I should assess each position's future prospects and contribution to total portfolio risk, not focus on realized profits.","Selling Stock D and E at large losses was painful. I should set clear, forward-looking criteria for holding or selling and avoid letting either my average cost or loss aversion dictate the decision.","Recent months without trades show that frequent monitoring does not require frequent action. I should review diversification and cash needs, then trade only when it improves the portfolio's risk and return prospects."]}
